articles.title: Melbourne Summit to Focus on Humanitarian Law, International Justice, and Armed Conflict
articles.description: Melbourne, Australia (HRNW) — International legal experts, human rights lawyers, and humanitarian researchers will convene in Melbourne from November 26–27, 2026, for the International Conference on Humanitarian Law, International Justice, and Human Rights (IHLIJHR 2026). articles.title: Artwork honouring children killed in Gaza on show after being dropped by council
articles.description: An artwork naming more than 18,000 children killed in Gaza has been displayed on the NSW South Coast, after it was dropped by a local council for posing an "unacceptable level of risk".
